hook: I want clinicians to trust every line they act on

builtFor.context: Vera is the clinical app clinicians reach for between patients. Its answers are cited; the next step is making each line easy to check in the seconds a clinician has.

opportunities.title: Claim Check
opportunities.body: Each claim labelled and one tap from its passage.

opportunities.title: Honest certainty
opportunities.body: Evidence grade per claim, and 'partly supported' when it is.

opportunities.title: Local protocols
opportunities.body: Where the hospital's guide differs, opened at the page.

body: My work has been in products where people act on what a system tells them: transaction monitoring at Youverify, lending at Shecluded.
I design for people under time pressure who need to know when to trust the system and when to check, and I prototype in code with AI tools.

bring.title: Trust in automated systems
bring.body: Tools where people act on what a system flagged and know when to step in.

bring.title: Design systems
bring.body: A component library that cut developer onboarding by 45%.

bring.title: AI-assisted prototyping
bring.body: Working prototypes in code, like this one.

systemsGets: Someone who designs the states of trust in an answer (supported, partly, conflicting, local) and makes them consistent everywhere.

opportunity.title: Claim Check
opportunity.problem: Citations sit at the level of the answer, so checking a line means hunting through a source, and local protocols can differ.
opportunity.solution: Per-claim support labels and grades, the exact passage one tap away, and local protocol differences flagged with the page.

firstWeek.intro: My first week would focus on how clinicians use Vera on shift, then shipping one improvement with the founders.

days.body: Meet the team. Use Vera for real clinical questions and note friction.
Talk to clinicians and watch them check answers between patients.
Agree on one moment to improve, grounded in what they did.
Prototype it and review the details with engineering.
Ship it, or share it for testing, with a plan to measure it.

ask: I'd love to be Vera's founding designer and help clinicians trust every answer.
